equation: W = DeltaU + DeltaK + D + DeltaUc - Jc + residual
boundary_work: Actual saved grip displacement times trapezoidal reaction plus exact change of prescribed grip kinetic energy; numerical quadrature estimate, not exact continuous work.
native_sources: Full variational exported U; native KE with physical mass; native epair*V; fixed-x signed U_old-U_new for D.
no_double_count: Signed bond topology=-D is displayed but never added again. Residual is not damage dissipation. All damping is exactly absent.
interpretation: Bounded observed residual; damage splitting and quadrature errors are explicit. No global time convergence or continuous-work exactness claim.
